def algorithm(func, dim, lb, ub, budget, rng):
    x = rng.uniform(lb, ub, size=dim)
    schedule = np.linspace(1, 0.01, int(budget * 2))
    best = func(x)
    for i in range(int(budget)):
        temp = rng.choice(schedule, p=np.array(schedule) / sum(schedule))
        candidate = x + temp * rng.normal(size=dim)
        candidate = np.clip(candidate, lb, ub)
        new = func(candidate)
        if new < best:
            best = new
            x = candidate
    return x
